method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse reconstruction of the inductive formula definition and structural-induction example, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, label, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: The introductory formula definition for a simple first-order language, its atomic and constructor clauses, its limiting clause, and the resulting structural-induction method.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Sentences are formulas without free variables, a distinction needed both for a manageable definition and for satisfaction. In the simplified language, P and a are the sole predicate and constant, negation, conjunction and existential quantification are the logical symbols, and a plus infinitely many variables are the current terms; fuller languages also include functions.
samples.checks: Free/bound contrast, semantic motivation, simplified inventory, planned generalization, function-built terms and v_i variable supply are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Frm contains the displayed atomic formulas, is closed under negation, conjunction and existential quantification, and contains nothing else.
samples.checks: Both atomic schemas, the natural-number index, all three constructors, the variable side condition and the limiting clause are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Starting from atomic formulas, the clauses generate new formulas. Repeated negation and quantification are admitted, including vacuous and nested quantification, while a negation with unsupported outer parentheses is excluded by the limiting clause.
samples.checks: Every cited clause, displayed example, inclusion claim and extraneous-parentheses exclusion is preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The inductive definition supports structural induction: prove the atomic cases and show preservation under negation, conjunction and existential quantification. Replaying those steps reaches the displayed quantified negation, and every formula is generated this way.
samples.checks: Both cross-references, all constructor cases, the concrete P(v_2) derivation and the universal generation conclusion remain exact.

source_observations: The target uses विगमनाधारित व्याख्या for inductive definition and decision T203 संरचनात्मक विगमन for induction on formula construction.
The limiting clause is translated with exclusive force and the outer-parenthesis counterexample remains excluded rather than normalized silently.
All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, labels, identifiers and references match exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The language is intentionally simplified and postpones the general definitions.
The exact Marathi headword संरचनात्मक विगमन is compositional and remains expert-reviewable under T203.
